1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
3	  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
4	  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
5	  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
6	  a formula or a road user is.
7	
8	  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
9	  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
10	  on a witness, false only when covered.
11	-/
12	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Temporal
17	
18	def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
19	def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)
20	
21	-- pointwise connectives
22	def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
23	def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
24	def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
25	def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
26	def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
27	def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)
28	
29	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
31	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
33	  let n := vals.size
34	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
35	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
36	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1
37	
38	private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
39	  let n := vals.size
40	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
41	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
42	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1
43	
44	/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
45	def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
46	/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
47	def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
48	/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
49	def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
50	  let n := ψ.size
51	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
52	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
53	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
54	/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
55	def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
56	  let n := ψ.size
57	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
58	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
59	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
60	/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
61	def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
62	/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
63	def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
64	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!
65	
66	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
68	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
70	    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
71	    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
72	    adequately sampled. -/
73	def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
74	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
75	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
76	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
77	    match wins[i]! with
78	    | none => R.u missing
79	    | some w =>
80	      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
81	      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
82	      else agg.all w.j0 i
83	
84	/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
85	    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
86	private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
87	  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
88	    match acc with
89	    | some r => some r
90	    | none =>
91	      let j := i - k
92	      match ψ[j]!.v with
93	      | .t => some φ[j]!
94	      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
95	      | .f => none) none
96	
97	/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
98	    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
99	    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
100	    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
101	    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
102	def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
103	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
104	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
105	    match wins[i]! with
106	    | none => R.u missing
107	    | some w =>
108	      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
109	      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
110	      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f
111	
112	/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
113	    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
114	def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
115	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
116	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
117	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
118	    match wins[i]! with
119	    | none => R.u missing
120	    | some w =>
121	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
122	      else
123	        let a := agg.any i w.jl
124	        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)
125	
126	/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
127	def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
128	  let n := vals.size
129	  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
130	    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
131	
132	/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
133	    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
134	    already failed. -/
135	def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
136	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
137	  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
138	  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
139	  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
140	  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
141	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
142	    match wins[i]! with
143	    | none => R.u missing
144	    | some w =>
145	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
146	      else
147	        let b := firstψ[i]!
148	        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
149	        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
150	        let witnessed : R :=
151	          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
152	          else
153	            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
154	            let a := firstφf[i]!
155	            let hi := min a w.jl
156	            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
157	            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
158	            else
159	              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
160	                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
161	              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
162	        if w.covered then witnessed
163	        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))
164	
165	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
166	-- Runs and counts
167	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168	/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
169	    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
170	    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
171	    begun before the recording). -/
172	def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
173	  let n := vals.size
174	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
175	    let v := vals[i]!
176	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
177	      match v.v with
178	      | .t =>
179	        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
180	        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
181	          | .t => acc.2
182	          | .f => .ok (some i)
183	          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
184	      | .f => acc.2
185	      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
186	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
187	
188	/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
189	    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
190	    reaches the trace start. -/
191	def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
192	  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
193	  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
194	    match holds[i]!.v with
195	    | .f => .ok Q.zero
196	    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
197	    | .t =>
198	      match starts[i]! with
199	      | .error e => .error e
200	      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
201	      | .ok (some j) =>
202	        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
203	        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
204	        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")
205	
206	/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
207	def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
208	  let n := edge.size
209	  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
210	  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
211	  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
212	    if k = 0 then .ok false
213	    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
214	      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
215	      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
216	      | .t, .f => .ok true
217	      | _, _ => .ok false
218	  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
219	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
220	  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
221	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
222	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
223	    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
224	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
225	    match starts[i]! with
226	    | .error e => .error e
227	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
228	    | .ok (some j) =>
229	      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
230	      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
231	        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
232	      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)
233	
234	/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
235	    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
236	    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
237	    before the first observation among them. -/
238	def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
239	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
240	    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))
241	
242	/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
243	    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
244	def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
245	  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
246	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
247	    match starts[i]! with
248	    | .error e => .error e
249	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
250	    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)
251	
252	/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
253	    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
254	def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
255	  let n := vals.size
256	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
257	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
258	      match acc.2 with
259	      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
260	      | .error e => .error e
261	      | .ok none =>
262	        match vals[i]!.v with
263	        | .t => .ok (some i)
264	        | .f => .ok none
265	        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
266	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
267	
268	
269	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
270	-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
271	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
272	section Lengths
273	
274	/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
275	theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
276	    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
277	    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
278	  induction l generalizing init with
279	  | nil => rfl
280	  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]
281	
282	theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
283	theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
284	theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
285	theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
286	theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]
287	
288	private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
289	    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
290	  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
291	
292	private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
293	    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
294	  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
295	
296	theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
297	theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
298	theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
299	theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
300	  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
301	theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
302	  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
303	theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
304	theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
305	    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
306	theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
307	    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
308	theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
309	    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
310	theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
311	    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
312	theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
313	    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
314	theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
315	    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
316	theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
317	theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
318	  simp [sinceRiseAll]
319	
320	end Lengths
321	
322	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
323	-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
324	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
325	section HoldsFor
326	
327	theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
328	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
329	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
330	      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
331	      | none => R.u missing
332	      | some w =>
333	        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
334	        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
335	        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
336	  unfold holdsForAll
337	  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
338	  simp
339	
340	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
341	    the result false. -/
342	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
343	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
344	    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
345	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
346	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
347	  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]
348	
349	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
350	    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
351	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
352	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
353	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
354	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
355	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
356	  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
357	    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
358	    hn j h1 h2 h3
359	  simp [hc, this]
360	
361	/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
362	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
363	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
364	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
365	    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by

367	  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
368	  split at hf
369	  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
370	    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
371	  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]

theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]

private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
  simp [sinceRiseAll]

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section HoldsFor

theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
      | none => R.u missing
      | some w =>
        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
  unfold holdsForAll
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
    the result false. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
    hn j h1 h2 h3
  simp [hc, this]

/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
  split at hf
  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

end HoldsFor

end Temporal
end TrafficSpec

37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
57	/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
64	  let ab := vsub b a
65	  let ap := vsub p a
66	  let l2 := normSq ab
67	  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
68	  else
69	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
70	    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
71	/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
72	def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
73	  let n := poly.length
74	  if n < 3 then false
75	  else
76	    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
77	    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
78	      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
79	      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
80	        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
81	        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
82	         !Q.isZero dy &&
83	         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
84	    crossings.length % 2 == 1
85	/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
86	def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
87	  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
88	  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
89	/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
90	def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
91	  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
92	/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
93	def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
94	  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
95	  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
96	    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
97	/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
98	def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
99	  let n := poly.length
100	  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
101	/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
102	    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
103	def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
104	  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
105	    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
106	/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
107	def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
108	  match poly with
109	  | [] => none
110	  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
111	  | _ =>
112	    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
113	    else
114	      let n := poly.length
115	      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
116	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
117	/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
118	def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
119	  let ab := vsub b a
120	  let l2 := normSq ab
121	  if Q.isZero l2 then a
122	  else
123	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
124	    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
125	/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
126	def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
127	  match poly with
128	  | [] => none
129	  | [a] => some a
130	  | _ =>
131	    let n := poly.length
132	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
133	    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
134	      | none => some c
135	      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
136	/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
137	    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
138	def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
139	  match poly with
140	  | [] => []
141	  | [a] => [a]
142	  | _ =>
143	    let n := poly.length
144	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
145	    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
146	    | [] => []
147	    | d :: ds =>
148	      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
149	      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

502	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
503	def sig_turn_indicator (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option TurnIndicatorState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.turnIndicator)
504	def sig_brake_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.brakeLamp)

516	def sig_hand_signal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HandSignal := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.handSignal)

521	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
522	-- Environment
523	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
524	def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
525	def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
526	def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad

528	def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
529	def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime
530	
531	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532	-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
533	-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
534	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d
538	  | none => do
539	    let pa ← kin_position s a
540	    let pb ← kin_position s b
541	    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))
542	
543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false
587	def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a
589	
590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))
606	
607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)
622	
623	/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633	
634	/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643	
644	/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
646	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero
649	
650	/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)
652	
653	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT of TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms. Generated from Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean by
  ontology_provenance/nrs_tools/atoms_train.py: the definitions of the atoms whose only textual
  support is a test line are omitted. Do not edit; regenerate.

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
  The bijection with the atoms of ATOMS.md: exactly one definition per atom id, named `family_name`,
  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the
  atom's name plus a suffix (`dev_traffic_signal_shows`, `ru_rider_posture_on_seat`).

  Rules of this file, held by the doctor:
  - every `\`family.name\`` in ATOMS.md has exactly one `def family_name` here and vice versa;
  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's
    or a derived concept's business;
  - the `rel_*` atoms may compute geometry from kinematics, because their contract says they are
    "computed from kinematics; listed because a source may supply them measured" — a measured
    value, when the source gives one, is preferred; `rel_visible` reads a measured value only.

  Every atom is three-valued: `none` is "not observed on this source".
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions

namespace TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
  if Q.isZero m then none
  else
    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
    let n := norm b
    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
end Geom

/-- Whether the road user carries one of the listed classes: true when it carries one; unknown when
    none holds and a listed class is unobserved (or the classes were not observed at all); false
    otherwise. A legal aggregate's membership is read through it, once for the classes its
    definition includes and once for those it leaves unresolved. -/
def ru_aggregate (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (members : List RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u =>
    let has : List (Option Bool) := members.map fun c =>
      if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)
    if has.any (· == some true) then some true
    else if has.any (·.isNone) then none
    else some false

-- Road structure and occupancy
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

/-- Whether a region is of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind`); unknown for a region not in the scene. -/
def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

def st_lane_adjacency_right (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option RegionId := (st_lane_adjacency s r).bind (·.rightNeighbour)

/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its left: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is first from the left, unknown where neither the neighbour nor the lane's place
    is observed. -/
def st_lane_left_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_left s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none => if st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r == some 1 then some false else none
/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its right: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is last of the lanes in its direction. -/
def st_lane_right_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_right s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none =>
    match st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r, st_lane_adjacency_count s r with
    | some o, some n => if o == n then some false else none
    | _, _ => none

/-- Whether line `l` marks carrier `a`'s entrance: decided where the line's entrances are observed,
    false for a region known to be neither a stop line nor a crosswalk, unknown otherwise. -/
def st_entrance_of (s : Scene) (l a : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? l).bind fun st =>
    if st.entranceObserved then some (st.entranceOf.contains a)
    else match isKind s l .stopLine, isKind s l .crosswalk with
      | some false, some false => some false
      | _, _ => none
